<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to an SN2 substitution where a C‑N bond is broken and a C‑Cl (halide) bond is formed. Using the provided molecule, the likely disconnection is the benzylic C‑N bond (the “CN4CC(F)C4” side chain). We'll search the template catalog for forward reactions that break a halide and form a C‑N bond, i.e., SN2 reactions.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-N"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-Cl"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
